name: University of Toronto
notes: Undergraduate admission asks 6.5 with no band below 6.0. The School of Graduate Studies sets a higher bar of 7.0 with at least 6.5 in each component (sgs.utoronto.ca). Scores must be achieved on a single test date; the IELTS Indicator and One Skill Retake are not accepted.

name: University of British Columbia
notes: The English Language Admission Standard is 6.5 with no part less than 6.0. IELTS General, IELTS Indicator and the One Skill Retake are not accepted — only IELTS Academic. Graduate programmes set their own figures and are not covered here.

name: McGill University
notes: Undergraduate admission asks 6.5 or better with individual component scores of 6.0 or better. Both IELTS Academic and IELTS for UKVI are accepted; the One Skill Retake is not. Scores must be sent electronically by the test centre. Graduate programmes set their own figures.

name: McMaster University
notes: Undergraduate admission asks 6.5 overall with a minimum of 6.0 in each of the four components. Individual graduate programmes (Engineering, Medical Sciences, Public Policy) publish their own figures, mostly in the same 6.5/6.0 range, and are not consolidated here.

name: University of Waterloo
notes: Waterloo's standard path asks 6.5 overall with 6.5 in writing and speaking and 6.0 in reading and listening — a higher floor on the productive skills than the receptive ones, which is unusual. A flat alternative of 7.0 overall with no component below 6.0 is also accepted. Only tests taken on or after 1 May 2025 are accepted at time of writing.

name: Simon Fraser University
notes: Standard undergraduate entry is 6.5 overall with no component below 6.0. Graduate admission is set by the Faculty of Graduate Studies per programme and is not covered here.

name: Dalhousie University
notes: Standard undergraduate entry is 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each component. The School of Architecture asks for 7.0 instead. Graduate admission is set per faculty and is not covered here.

name: Queen's University
notes: Standard undergraduate entry is 6.5 on the Academic Module with no band below 6.0. Graduate programmes generally ask for 7.0 or higher and are set per department — the English Literature MA/PhD asks 7.5.

name: Carleton University
notes: Direct admission without an ESL requirement needs 6.5 overall with no band below 6.0. A lower score can still lead to conditional admission with mandatory English language coursework in first year.

name: University of Victoria
notes: Standard undergraduate entry is 6.5 overall with no component less than 6.0. Some programmes ask for more — one example programme requires 7.0 overall with no component below 6.5.

name: University of Calgary
notes: Standard undergraduate requirement is 6.5 overall; the university's page does not publish a per-skill minimum alongside it. Nursing and Education ask for 7.0.

name: University of Manitoba
notes: Standard undergraduate entry is 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each of the four modules. Law is far higher: 7.0 overall with no section below 7.0.
